markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, unanimous neighbors, and second-model agreement all support Normal [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 99%, Benign 1% | Strongly favors Normal |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 58th percentile | Typical, reliable input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 0, 10) · ↓ invasive · Score above typical; associated with lower invasive likelihood · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Low score here; weak pull away from invasive · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 6) · ↓ invasive · Strongest in region 6; modest pull away from invasive · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Near-typical score; small push toward invasive · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect classifier. This case leans on normal lobules and mitoses, both Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Stain degradation (severity 3) distorted features despite high reliability; error AUROC is only 0.69.
- Region 8 holds a small invasive focus; its stroma-infiltration score is highest there.

## Check on the slide
1. **8**: Look for infiltrating tumor in stroma; highest infiltration score.
2. **0, 10**: Confirm two-layered epithelium in lobules; this concept failed its spot check.
3. **5**: Confirm ducts lack atypia; duct-confined concept scored only 12/20 on spot check.
